title: Box 15.01 Important reporting elements for resection of liver metastases
tablehtml:
·    Origin of primary tumour

·    Histological subtype

·    Number of metastases

·    Maximum dimensions of metastases

·    Growth pattern of metastases

·    Extent of invasion (penetration of the capsule, extrahepatic extension)

·    Vascular invasion / biliary tract invasion / perineural invasion

·    Resection margins

·    Lymph nodes and lymph node status

·    Coexistent pathology
